text:
alyssa: afternoon — quick async standup:
- what I did: landed microbatch slotting wrapfix in kernel (PR #4287), added unit test for slot rollover, updated batcher heuristics to prefer short-first for <128 tokens. ran microbench against staging: p50 11ms -> 10.5ms, p95 118ms -> 111ms.
- blockers: seeing a memgrowth on canary after ~6h under sustained qps (likely KV eviction thrash). traces show repeated full-cache walks.
- today: investigate memgrowth root cause, add more detailed KV miss logging, roll canary from 10% -> 25% if stable. also follow up on batching fallback logic.

pranav: nice! skimmed #4287 — left two nits re: comments and a minor race in slot index. can you add an assert in slot_alloc to catch wrap? also saw a weird regression in long-seq paths in one perf run (2k tokens) — might be unrelated.

alyssa: thanks — added the assert and pushed fix, test included. that long-seq regression correlates with our debug build, not production kernel. re-running perf with release flags.

marla: heads-up: I'm trying a conservative eviction threshold change on canary to reduce churn — set eviction.max_fill = 0.55 for the next 3 hours. rolling via ops runbook now.

marla: config snippet:
```yaml
kv_eviction:
  max_fill: 0.55
  decay_ms: 120000
  hot_threshold: 8
```

diego: pulled numbers from the perf dashboard after Alyssa's PR: p50 12ms -> 11ms, p95 120ms -> 112ms across mixed workloads. spikes still appear around ~2k tokens (heap churn). I added a transient counter for kv_miss_rate to the canary. link: https://perf.redwood/internal/dash/slotting

sam: CI flakiness on gpu-emulator popped up for unrelated test suite — kicked a re-run (/retest). if anyone sees tests failing repeatedly ping me.

ci-bot: CI: PR #4287 — all checks passed (unit, integration, microbench smoke).

pranav: small ask — can we gate the canary roll on kv_miss_rate < 0.02 for 10m? otherwise it might amplify the thrash.

alyssa: good call — adding a check in the rollout script. patching canary job to check metrics before bump.

diego: note for follow-up: run a microbench with synthetic prefix-caching (repeat prefix) to validate KV hot-paths. I can spin up a 30m run later today.

alyssa: perfect. if anyone has short items: drop them here. otherwise I'll update the canary playbook once the new metric gate is in. :thumbsup:

marla: will monitor eviction stats and call out if miss_rate > 0.03.

sam: thanks all — /retest completed and passes.

alyssa: closing loop — will post a quick post-canary summary in the morning with p95 deltas and root-cause notes.
